subject.title: improve(control-ui): expose linear session positions in chat picker

question: Should OpenClaw accept this narrow Control UI chat-picker accessibility slice now, after resolving the current-main conflict, while leaving the broader linear workspace request open?
rationale: The patch is bounded and proof-positive, but the PR has a protected maintainer label and is explicitly an incremental slice of a broader accessibility product request.

options.title: Accept Narrow Slice After Rebase
options.body: Resolve the chat-pane.ts conflict, preserve current-main symbol cleanup, and land the picker ordinal/current-session cue as an incremental accessibility improvement.

options.title: Hold For Broader Workspace Design
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define the full linear workspace accessibility direction from the linked broader issue.

options.title: Request A Different Accessibility Target
options.body: Ask the contributor to retarget the patch if maintainers prefer a different first accessibility slice than the split-pane session picker.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Slice After Rebase
recommendation.body: Resolve the chat-pane.ts conflict, preserve current-main symbol cleanup, and land the picker ordinal/current-session cue as an incremental accessibility improvement.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent Control UI/session work and the current ChatPane blame make this the best available product-review route among the likely owners.
